hero.bio: Front-end developer, four years in React and its ecosystem. Government portals, real-time data platforms and AI training environments for clients including Microsoft and Amazon.

description: Production-ready sandbox environments for AI agent training, serving clients such as Microsoft and Amazon.
Co-led projects: requirements, task assignment, progress and reviews in the lead's absence.
Cut manual QA effort by 50% with a prompt-engineering and assertion-testing pipeline.
Met 100% of sprint deadlines after introducing structured AI tooling (Cursor) with team guidelines.
Shipped the INSPIRE government portal with the Brazilian Ministry of Management and Innovation, end to end, under strict WCAG and performance requirements.
Raised critical-flow test coverage past 85% with Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library and Playwright.
Built a real-time voice-biometrics visualization with React, WebSockets and ApexCharts — top client satisfaction score.
Evolved the proprietary Design System used across 30+ applications; host of the internal Frontend Chapter.
Delivered the billing and debt-negotiation module of the Billing project from kickoff to closure.
Reduced rework across frontend, backend and design through pair programming and continuous alignment.
Promoted to full-time Frontend Developer at the end of the internship.
Cut application load time by 90% by optimizing Bling and Mercado Livre API integrations with caching strategies.
Led the full modernization of a legacy app to React, TypeScript and Redux.
Built an interactive ApexCharts dashboard with filters and pagination over REST APIs.
Shipped accessible, responsive web applications with React, JavaScript, CSS3 and Material UI.
Improved platform UX with a cross-functional team, driven by direct user feedback.
